description: Agent Events: submit a venue arrangement record with the requirements in the event brief: the arrangement with the event, venue, room, the day held, the room capacity, each layout or format it supports, each access and accessibility provision it records, when setup access begins and when the hold begins and ends; the requirements with the event, the day, the capacity, the layout the event needs, each access or accessibility need, when setup access is needed and the hours the event needs the room. The signed report gives the arrangement and the requirements, the day, the capacity, the layout against each layout supported, each provision needed against those recorded, the hold against the hours needed and setup access against the setup needed, and counts them, and names a divergent arrangement: another day, a capacity below the brief, a layout the room does not support, a required provision missing, a hold that starts after or ends before the hours needed and setup access later than the brief needs; then another event name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A requirement the arrangement states nothing for, or a brief that states none, leaves the arrangement unverified. Capacity compares as a count, layouts and provisions read by their words with plurals folded, and hours compare to the minute, setup access read from the hold where no separate access is stated. This reads the event’s own venue arrangement wherever the event is held: the Agent Travel family, such as wever_travel-itinerary-check, reads trip records, the itineraries, fares, passengers, changes and disruptions of a journey, and travel to an event is not read here, while the venue check reads the event’s own records wherever it is held; and wever_accessibility-evidence-check reads a digital accessibility statement or conformance claim, while the venue check reads the physical access provisions a venue arrangement records against the needs the brief states. Verdict event_venue_divergent, event_venue_partial, event_venue_unverified or event_venue_consistent. POST /api/event-venue-check. Reads the event records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never books a venue, registers or invites anyone, sells or refunds a ticket, publishes an announcement, or judges whether an event should happen, was well run, or was worth attending, only whether its records agree with each other and with what was announced, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Events reads an organized event’s records for consistency between documents: an event brief, a published agenda, speaker confirmations, a registration list, a venue arrangement, a ticketing record, a public announcement and a post-event report, each against the requirements, plan, lineup, capacity and eligibility terms, brief, announced terms, schedule or records it should agree with. Beside it, the Standing jobs rail tools such as wever_schedule-create register, list, report on and cancel recurring jobs and keep state, and wever_meeting-brief states one meeting’s decisions and action items from its notes, while this family keeps no state, registers nothing, runs nothing and reads the records in the call against each other and against what was announced. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-events-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-events/.
